notes.title: 1.42 Content & Improvement Patch + Uncensor Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29777768/c32d8d80ca6ad729e04c3df91b6a0126e6dbe52f.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 

It's been awhile since our last patch, but thanks to the recent steam policy changes, we thought what better way to usher in a new patch than to uncensor the game at the same time. 1.42 isn't nearly as big of an update as 1.4, but it's added and improved a number of things. Here's the changelog:

[b]Content Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] NG+ Mode Added, accessible after beating the game once through content pack menu. [i]NG+ adds a few things - An "autoseduce" button to instantly access h-scenes with non-boss enemies, all maps fully unlocked by default (except all world map locations), and the ability to manually increase/decrease karma from the player screen[/i]
[*] True Ending Added (+ 2 other bonus events, one of which is a precursor to accessing the ending), only accessible in NG+
[*] 2 new Nisha events, 1 new Aditi event, 1 new annavere event, all added at the ends of their respective routes
[*] 4 new achievements added
[/list]

[b]Quality Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Added bubble & fade animations to damage text in battle
[*]You can now navigate maps by clicking to any discovered bubble node and the cursor will autopath there - [i] No more excessive clicking![/i]
[*]You can now click on the bubble you're currently on to access the events there; no more moving the mouse to the Explore button and back
[*] [b]IMPORTANT[/b] - You can now control the speed at which battles happen. This menu appears in the player menu on the left hand side, and carries over between saves.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash happening with various spells, including Void Fire
[*]Fixed a bug which sometimes prevented Saanvi from appearing in her last position in Vritra's End
[*]Fixed a bug in which certain dialogues would be skipped for enemy h-scenes
[*]Fixed bugs with certain Vari progressions not progressing correctly depending on other variables
[*]Fixed various typos throughout the game
[*]Achievements should be working again as well in this current version
[/list]

In addition, the game [b]has been uncensored[/b]. Furthermore, the game now runs a universal version, so the Steam version and Nutaku/etc versions are now identical.

[b]Information:[/b]
Website: http://tophat.studio
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TopHatStudiosEN
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Top-Hat-Studios-Inc-169812676503202/
Tumblr: https://tophatstudios.tumblr.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/yy7javF

Also!!! Be sure to follow our publisher page on Steam for more information and future releases, just click the "Follow" button.
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/tophatstudios

We hope you enjoy!

notes.title: New Game Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

If you enjoyed Karmasutra, we wanted to let everyone know we have a new game live which we've developed in-house as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/846250/Devious/

Devious is a real time dungeon-crawler with visual novel story-telling, but it can also be played as a pure VN (or a pure dungeon crawler). It's also our first 3D game, so it's a very exciting release for us! Much like Karmasutra, it's a very long game, totaling 20-30+ hours, and also has a free patch available.

The game is 10% off for the next week as well to celebrate launch, so it's the perfect time to pick the game up if it looks interesting to you.

notes.title: 1.4 Release + Patch Instructions & FAQ
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29777768/1ca52fec36b9aa3494b5391eec10cea30736a082.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

The long awaited 1.4 Patch is finally here. The patch will install automatically, but will require a redownload and reinstallation of the uncensor patch if wanted. Below is a list of changes and FAQ about the patch.

[b]Changelog: [/b]
-Added Content Pack Selection
-Added h-scenes for all enemies
-Added an extra h-scene at the end of Einya's Hidden/Alternative Ending
-Added new interaction scenes between Saanvi and Lydria
-Added a new NPC, Vari, who has a new route, 2 new game endings, and a conversation feature to converse with inhabitants as they move to Vatika. Also has a new h-scene.
-Fixed various smaller bugs throughout the game that may have caused annoyances to players

[b]New Uncensor Patch[/b]

[u] IMPORTANT - USE THIS DOWNLOAD LINK BELOW, DO [b]NOT[/b] USE THE OLD UNCENSOR PATCH AS IT IS NOT YET UPDATED TO 1.4[/u]

Download link: 

MIRROR 1: https:// mega. nz /#!X1oSmBrL!i_DgKaHp0ZOVQ5lViLXmirwByARbYkdXmgern4qTV58 (remove all spaces)

or 

MIRROR 2: http:// www. mediafire .com/file/s7g7eec52vspibc/1.4%20Uncensor%20Patch.zip (remove all spaces)


Instructions for install:
Unzip the folder somewhere.
Navigate to your Steam/steamapps/common folder.
Find the Karmasutra folder.
Merge (copy/paste or drag into the directory) the downloaded "game" folder with the "game" folder in the Karmasutra folder.
When asked if you want to replace files, click yes.

[b]F.A.Q[/b]

1. My games does not have 1.4 content, what do I do?
In order for 1.4 Content to appear, you [b]MUST START A NEW GAME[/b] and select the "1.4 Content Pack" option at the beginning of the game.

2. Will older files be affected?
Older files will be unaffected by 1.4 changes - outside of bug fixes - but will not have 1.4 content added.

3. Can I still access the non-1.4 version of the game?
Yes, in the Content Pack Selection when starting a new game, select the "No Content Packs" option to access the "Vanilla" game without the added 1.4 content.

4. [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] How do I access enemy h-scenes?
In order to access enemy h-scenes, an enemy must first be the last standing member of an enemy party, and must have their clothes ripped. A successful Flirt/Charm/Tease attempt (through the Talk option) and the last remaining enemy will then result in the h-scene.

5. [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Where are the new h-scenes in the gallery?
Once the last page is reached, keep clicking the arrow and the new pages will appear. They are currently not numbered but exist in the gallery.

6. I've found a bug, what should I do?
Please report it to the developer either on the steam forums or in the discord server and it will be fixed ASAP. 


If you're enjoying the game and would like to talk to the developers and other players, and ask questions, report bugs, and just have fun with the community, feel free to join our discord server.
https://discord.gg/yy7javF

Have fun everyone!

notes.title: Project Sense is on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Hopefully everyone is enjoying Karmasutra. Update 1.4 - the free content update - is currently scheduled to be released in the next month. While we wait for that release, a friend of ours has put their kickstarter live recently.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2030067069/project-sense-a-cyberpunk-ghost-story-adventure?ref=user_menu

The game is a mix between old school adventure games such as Clock Tower with lots of inspiration from blade runner & fatal frame. There's also quite a bit of fanservice if that's your thing.

If it looks interesting to you, be sure to check out.

notes.title: Information About The Project
notes.content:
Karmasutra has been released elsewhere as an ero-game/h-game, so as people can probably guess there is a good amount of content not suitable for audiences under 18.

The game is available for sale uncensored elsewhere - such as on Nutaku - but this version contains small changes to make it more suitable for a larger platform release.  If you have bought the game there - or through our Kimochi campaign earlier this year - then you can recieve a free steam key upon release. We'll release more information about this in the near future.

You can follow us (and tweet at us for any questions you may have) on our twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/TopHatStudiosEN ] Link Here [/url] 

We're also aware that elsewhere the launch of the game was shaky at best - we've apologized for this in the past, it was a learning experience and definitely something which we regret that we let happen. This launch will be on the most recent build of the game, which is stable.

We hope everyone will enjoy the game once it's released.
